content: Xoossa Dunkaane Tolo
Hessafe guye GODAY Muse,
«Koyro aginan koyro gallas, neni Xoossa Dunkaane tola.
Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa iza giddon woththada Taabotaza magalashan genththa.
Xaraphpheezaa gelththada iza bolla wodhdhanaas koshshiza miishshata ubbaa iza bolla woththa. Histtada xomppeta iza bolla woththiza miishshaza soo gelththada iza bolla xomppeta woththa.
Worqqafe oosettida exaane cuwasizasoza Caaqo Qaala Taabotaa sinththan woththada, Xoossa Dunkaaneza giddo geliza penge magalashaza kaqqa.
«Xuugettiza yarsho yarshizasoza Xoossa Dunkaanezi geliza penge sinththan woththa.
Izan meecettiza kereza Xoossa Dunkaanezappenne yarshizasozappe giddon woththada haaththe izan tiga.
Xoossa Dunkaanezappe karera yuushsha aaththada Dunkaanezas kare bagga wuyge giigsada dubbushaa gelizason magalasha kaqqa.
«Tiyettiza zayteza ekkada Xoossa Dunkaanezanne iza giddon dizayssa ubbaa tiya; izanne iza giddon go7ettiza miishshata ubbaa dummasa; histtiko izi geesh gidana.
Hessafe guye xuugettiza yarsho yarshizasonne izas go7ettiza miishshaa ubbaa tiya; yarshizasoza dummasa; histtiko izi ubbaafe aadhdhida geesh gidana.
Meechcha kerezanne kereza iza bolla woththiza miishshata tiyada istta dummasa.
«Neni Aaroonenne iza nayta Xoossa Dunkaanezi geliza penge ehada haaththan meecca.
Hessafe guye qeeseteththa may7oza Aaroone mayzada izi taas qeeseteththan ooththana mala iza tiyada dummasa.
Iza attuma naytakka ehada qolle mayza.
Istti taas qeeseteththan ooththana mala, istta aawaa tiyda mala, isttaka tiya. Istta tiyeteththankka isttanne istta yeletay wuri qeese gididi ooththana mala ta ooththana» gides.
Musey ubbaaka GODAY bana azazida mala ooththides.
Hessa gishshas Gibxeppe istti kezida nam7anththo layththan, koyro aginan koyro gallassan Xoossa Dunkaaney tolettides.
Musey Xoossa Dunkaaneza essiza wode Dunkaaneza toho istta sohon sohon woththides; tole miththatanne tuussaa aaththides; gordiza miththatakka gelththides.
Hessafe guye Musey GODAY azazida mala dunkaaneza tolidi iza bollara kama kammides.
Histtidi tammu azazoti xaafettida masettida shuchchata efidi Taabotaza giddon woththides; tookkiza tooho miththata Taabotaan aaththides; maaroteththa kamaakka Taabotaa bolla woththides.
Hessafe guye Taabotaza Xoossa Dunkaaneza giddo gelththides; genththiza magalashaa kaqqidi, GODAY azazida mala Caaqo Qaala Taabotaza kammides.
GODAY Muse azazida mala, Musey xaraphpheezaza Xoossa Dunkaanezan gelththidi, magalashaappe karera hu7esora woththidi,
iza bolla GODAA sinththan woththiza geeshsha uketh giigsides.
GODAY Muse azazida mala, xomppe woththizasoza Xoossa Dunkaane giddo gelththidi, xaraphpheezas sinththa baggara, Xoossa Dunkaanezas tohosora woththides;
qasse xomppeta GODAA sinththan oyththides.
GODAY azazida mala, worqqafe oosettida exaane cuwasizasoza Xoossa Dunkaaneza giddo gelththidi magalashazas sinththa baggara woththidi,
iza bolla sawiza exaane cuwasides.
Hessafe guye Xoossa Dunkaaneza pengen magalashaa kaqqides.
Xuugettiza yarsho yarshizasoza Xoossa Dunkaane gelizaso penge achchan woththides; iza bolla xuugettiza yarshonne kaththa yarsho GODAY azazida mala yarshides.
Meechcha kereza Xoossa Dunkaanezappenne yarshizasozappe giddon woththides. Histtidi meecettanaas haaththe izan tigides.
Musey, Aarooneynne iza nayti ba kushenne ba toho izan meecettida.
GODAY Muse azazida mala, istti Xoossa Dunkaanen geliza wode woykko yarshizaso shiiqiza wode aydekka meecetteettes.
Xoossa Dunkaanen yarshizaso yuushshi aaththidi dubbusha giigsides; he dubbushaa pengen magalasha kaqqides. Hessaththo histtidi Musey oosoza polides.
Xoossa Dunkaanezan Godaa Bonchcho Kumo
Hessafe guye shaaray Xoossa Dunkaaneza kammides; GODAA bonchchoyka iza kumides.
Shaaray Xoossa Dunkaaneza bolla uttida gishshassinne GODAA bonchchoy iza giddon kumida gishshas Musey iza giddo gelanaas dandaybeenna.
Isra7eele asay ba oge ubbaan, he shaaray Xoossa Dunkaanezappe dendiza wode aydekka iza kaallidi beettes.
Gido attiin he shaaray dendontta ixxiko izi dendana gallassay gakkanaas isttika qaaxxettenna.
Istta oge ubbaan GODAA shaaray Isra7eele asay wuri be7ishin, gallas gallas Xoossa Dunkaane kammeessinne qamma qamma qasse tamay he shaaraa giddon eexxees.
